name: DurableCostMath
summary: Buy-it-for-life cost math for Swift: cost per decade, repair-vs-replace, and how much a longer lifespan justifies paying.
description:
Swift math for pricing durable goods by what they cost per year instead of
what the sticker says: annual cost, cost per decade, cost per use, the
lifespan a premium purchase must reach to break even, the price at which a
longer-lasting version stops being the bargain, when a repair beats a
replacement, and the annualized total cost of ownership once repairs enter
the picture. Pure Foundation, no dependencies, Decimal throughout so gear
audits never inherit floating-point drift. Built by the Durable Picks team,
which publishes cost-per-decade breakdowns and repairability scoring for
buy-it-for-life gear.
